thread:
anya: quick async check — docs + sampleapps. what I did: shipped quickstart rewrite for node+python, fixed a couple of wording nits in the embedding guide. blockers: sampleapp packaging fails on mac M1 (wheel build error), and one doc image is rendering blurry on the console page. today: triage the wheel build, push a small image replace, and cut a docs patch release if green. pinging folks who touched the sampleapp lately.

kai: saw the node quickstart, nice and concise. one minor nit in the npm install section — extra `--save` is unnecessary for modern npm. submitted a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/314

ravi: re: mac M1 wheel — I hit that yesterday too. error is from the native extension build step failing with `ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture arm64`. quick workaround is to use the universal2 wheel we produce on CI, but for devs on local M1 we should add a note in the README. I can add the note today.

anya: thanks. can you also dump the exact build error here? that helps me triage the sampleapp CI.

ravi: paste from my local run:

```
Building wheel for sampleapp (setup.py) ... error
  clang: error: unsupported option '-fno-plt' for target 'arm64-apple-darwin'
  ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture arm64
  error: command 'clang' failed with exit status 1
```

ravi: i suspect our build flags assume linux/x86. will try a quick patch to skip that flag on darwin.

jordan: i can take the doc image — have a higher-res export of the diagram. will upload to the assets bucket and update the MD ref. should be a 10–15m job.

anya: awesome. if we get the image and the CI note in place we can attempt a docs patch release tonight (low risk).

kai: quick question — do we want to add an explicit mac/arm troubleshooting section to the quickstart, or just the note in the sampleapp README? I vote both: short note in quickstart, deeper troubleshooting in sampleapp README with the exact error and workaround.

anya: agree. short note in quickstart (1–2 lines) + link to sampleapp troubleshooting page. kai can you add the short line to your PR?

kai: yep, i'll append it to PR 314.

ci-bot: github/actions — docs/ci passed for branch: fix/quickstart-nits (checks: linters, build, deploy-preview) :white_check_mark:

ravi: i'll open a follow-up PR for the wheel flag fix and add the local repro steps. if anyone wants to test locally, try: `python -m pip wheel .` inside a mac M1 env and share the full log.

anya: plan for today: (1) merge kai's PR after tiny edit, (2) jordan uploads image + I update MD ref, (3) ravi opens patch PR for build flags, (4) run docs patch release if CI stays green. blocking only if the build flag fix needs deeper change.

jordan: uploaded new diagram to gs://redwood-assets/docs/diagrams/quickstart-v2.png and updated the md preview in my branch, looks good in deploy preview.

anya: perfect. i'll wait for ravi's PR and then cut the release. thanks team! :raised_hands:
